overview_description.description: Checkars is a leading online marketplace for buying and selling used cars, headquartered our of Buenos Aires, Argentina.  Having sold 300 cars in its 1st year and founded by a duo of former OLX and Google executives experienced in the car vertical, Checkars is revolutionizing used-car buying and selling in Argentina.
